acceptanceCriteria: In packages/hollow-test/lib/runner.mjs, capture and return stdout and stderr from runTest (via classifyTestResult) so callers can inspect baseline failure output

In packages/hollow-test/bin/hollow-test.mjs, when baseline suite fails (baseline.status !== 0), emit the captured stdout and/or stderr to stderr (or format legibly) so the failure reasons and failing tests are visible before opError is called
Add test in packages/hollow-test/test/baseline-output.test.mjs verifying that non-zero baseline runs print the test command's output
Existing hollow-test test suite continues to pass
Update documentation in packages/hollow-test/README.md, docs/tools/hollow-test.md, and apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/hollow-test.mdx
title: hollow-test discards the baseline suite output on failure, making a red slow-path baseline undiagnosable (#288)
